description: This source file provides utility functions for extracting and processing protection metadata related to encrypted media streams in a GStreamer pipeline, specifically handling DRM-related data such as encryption schemes, keys, IVs, subsamples, and session IDs.

methods.name: getEncryptedFromProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Extracts the 'encrypted' boolean flag from protection metadata and updates the BufferProtectionMetadata object.

methods.name: getMediaKeySessionIdFromProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves the media key session ID from protection metadata and updates the BufferProtectionMetadata object.

methods.name: getKIDFromProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Extracts the key ID (KID) from protection metadata and stores it in the BufferProtectionMetadata object.

methods.name: getIVFromProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves the initialization vector (IV) from protection metadata and updates the BufferProtectionMetadata object.

methods.name: getSubSamplesFromProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Extracts subsample information (clear/encrypted byte counts) from protection metadata and updates the BufferProtectionMetadata object.

methods.name: getInitWithLast15FromProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves the 'init_with_last_15' flag from protection metadata.

methods.name: getEncryptionSchemeFromProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Determines the encryption scheme (cipher mode) from protection metadata and updates the BufferProtectionMetadata object.

methods.name: getEncryptionPatternFromProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves encryption pattern details (crypt and skip blocks) from protection metadata.

methods.name: ProcessProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Main function that processes a GstBuffer to extract and populate protection metadata into a BufferProtectionMetadata object.
